title: Notice on New Trading Pairs & Trading Bots Services on Binance Spot - 2024-01-11
text: Fellow Binancians, To expand the list of trading choices offered on Binance Spot and enhance users’ trading experience, Binance will open trading for the SKL/TRY, STX/FDUSD and TIA/FDUSD spot trading pairs at  2024-01-11 08:00 (UTC) . In addition, Binance will enable  Trading Bots  services for the following trading pairs at  2024-01-11 08:00 (UTC) .  Spot Grid, Spot DCA & Rebalancing Bot: AI/USDT, NFP/USDT Spot Algo Orders: SKL/TRY, STX/FDUSD, TIA/FDUSD   Start Trading on Binance Spot Now! Notes: TRY is a fiat currency and does not represent any other digital currencies. Users will enjoy zero maker fees on  FDUSD  trading pairs until further notice. There may be discrepancies in the translated version of this original article in English. Please reference this original version for the latest or most accurate information where any discrepancies may arise.  Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2024-01-10
